items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I know I’m going to enjoy talking to veteran drummer Eddie Alley.

ctx.x: Eddie was interviewed in San Francisco, California on August 8, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. His daughter was present at the interview and participated briefly.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I know I’m going to enjoy talking to veteran drummer Eddie Alley. It’s very nice to have you here.
